title: Figure 10: Light Waves at Cloaking Device – wave propagation in virtual and real space
description: Two color field plots of concentric purple-and-white wavefronts spreading from a point source, panel (a) on x'-y' axes and panel (b) on x-y axes, each from -2 to 3. In panel (b) the wavefronts bend around a shaded circular cloaked region. The caption reads "Figure 10. Light Waves at Cloaking Device. Wave propagation in (a) virtual space and (b) real space." The text introduces metamaterials.
